records.scope: Season 1, Chapters 1–8: selected-profile episode connections and supporting profiles; previously verified cast credits now link to the new character pages. Direct scenes can include noted flashbacks or transmissions involving the same person.
limitations: Season-one Chapters 1–8 were reviewed against 26 selected profiles. This is not a complete cast, place or vehicle inventory. Unlinked profiles remain unestablished, not absent; seasons 2–3 still need a systematic appearance review.
Episode inventory and writing credits do not establish every language mix, supplied master or frame-level version. Public references are not open media licences.
Dates remain scoped to cinema, television and streaming. No physical-media, purchase-download or classification dates are added in this supplement.

Released television Chapters 1–24 only. The feature, LEGO retelling and The Book of Boba Fett are separate works. WGA final Created by and Lucasfilm’s current editorial Creator wording are explicitly distinguished.
